sentences.text:
Shri A. G. Mate, Advocate for respondents/S
 Coram :- Avinash G. Gharote &
 M. W. Chandwani, Jj.
Dated :- 14.08.2024

There is no dispute regarding passing of the award dated 03.02.2023 under Section 28A of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 by the Land Acquisition Officer, Gondia, in which compensation of Rs.80,96,147/- has been awarded to the petitioner.
The only grievance is that the payment has not been done on the ground that grants have not been received.
2. The learned AGP for the State, on instructions, makes a statement that the payment shall be made within a period of three months from today.
3. Accepting which, the petition is disposed of in terms of the aforesaid statement.
(M. W. CHANDWANI, J.) (AVINASH G. GHAROTE, J.) Signed by: Mr. Rajnesh Jaiswal Designation: PARR ToJaiswal Honourable Judge
